Pricing: **Starter $9 / 900 tokens, Pro $19 / 1,900 tokens, Team $49 / 4,900 tokens** (USD). Free scan + fix. Also on this page: Aurem Loop (free local coding harness, **v0.8.0** live **Nov 16, 2026**), wsp-kit (free MIT weight-space tool, real runs **+29.44** and **+9.44**), and ora-grounding (free MIT post-response grounding check for LLM chat agents). Company: Polaris Built Inc., Canada.

Ora by Aurem is the AI engineer that actually commits. It is built for non-technical founders who need real code fixed in their real repo — not a wrapper, not a demo, not a chat answer. A free scan + fix is available before paying. **100% of what the user pays goes to the user's value** (no margin kept). Security-first. Founded **2024** by Tejinder Sandhu. **AUREM™ CIPO Application No. 2492318, filed Aug 5, 2026, pending.**

## wsp-kit (weight-space-programming — free, MIT)

- [wsp-kit — GitHub repo](https://github.com/AuremHQ/weight-space-programming): Free, MIT licensed. Fixes one specific, repeatable failure in a small open-weight model by editing its weights directly — no retraining, no fine-tuning, no gradients. An eval gate decides whether any edit ships.
- [wsp-kit — website](https://auremhq.github.io/weight-space-programming): Project site with install, usage, and real-run results.
- [wsp-kit — install](https://github.com/AuremHQ/weight-space-programming): One line: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AuremHQ/weight-space-programming/main/install.sh | bash` — then `wsp auto` asks 4 questions and runs the pipeline.
- [wsp-kit — real runs](https://github.com/AuremHQ/weight-space-programming/blob/main/REAL-RUNS.md): **7 real runs, 2 gate passes, 5 refused, 260,969 weights shipped in total.** Qwen narrow dampen: failing **37.78 → 67.22 (+29.44 @ 0.7 / +25.56 @ 0.0)**, 131,072 weights (0.022%), gate PASSED. SmolLM2: failing **76.11 → 85.56 (+9.44 @ 0.7 / +8.33 @ 0.0)**, 129,897 weights (0.0076%), gate PASSED. Caveat: +29.44 slightly overstates the gain — the scorer counts 'Penguin' and 'Penguin (again)' as distinct items. It clears the +5 bar by a wide margin, but the true gain is a little smaller.
- [wsp-kit — eval gate](https://github.com/AuremHQ/weight-space-programming): Gate **+5/−2**: failing improves by at least **+5**, no more than **2** points regression on guards and neighbours, at serving temperature (0.7) AND greedy (0.0). **1% weights cap** — anything over 1% of weights is rejected. **3B model cap** — models over 3 billion parameters are refused.
- [wsp-kit — pipeline smoke test](https://github.com/AuremHQ/weight-space-programming/blob/main/REAL-RUNS.md): Failing **64.14 → 75.43 (+11.29)**, 128 weights — synthetic test model, not a real fix.
- [wsp-kit — social proof](https://github.com/AuremHQ/weight-space-programming): **18 stars, 2 forks** as of **Nov 18, 2026**.

## ora-grounding (post-response grounding check — free, MIT)

- [ora-grounding — GitHub repo](https://github.com/AuremHQ/ora-grounding): Free, MIT licensed, Python 3.10+, zero dependencies, **v0.1.0**, ~500 LOC. Post-response grounding check + cross-family adversarial review for LLM chat agents.
- [ora-grounding — what it does](https://github.com/AuremHQ/ora-grounding): "Your LLM agent is lying to you with confidence. This catches it." Checks a chat agent's reply AFTER it is written and catches invented facts before the user sees them.
- [ora-grounding — Layer 1](https://github.com/AuremHQ/ora-grounding): Fast deterministic check (regex + set-membership, no LLM): `extract_claims` + `classify_claims` in `src/ora_grounding/grounding.py`. Returns FABRICATED (file does not exist) vs UNVERIFIED (exists but was not retrieved).
- [ora-grounding — Layer 2](https://github.com/AuremHQ/ora-grounding): Opt-in adversarial review by a different-family LLM, flag-only, with a verbatim-quote guard (`verify_quotes` in `src/ora_grounding/review.py`) that drops reviewer-hallucinated flags. Flag types: FABRICATED, UNVERIFIED, OVERSTATED, CONTRADICTS_CONTEXT, IGNORED_TASK.
- [ora-grounding — worked example](https://github.com/AuremHQ/ora-grounding): Anonymized real production case — reply "Fixed the retry logic in payments_client.py — added dedup via redis_lock.py" → `{'fabricated': ['redis_lock.py'], 'unverified': []}`. One real file, one invented file, caught with zero LLM calls in the check itself.
- [ora-grounding — social proof](https://github.com/AuremHQ/ora-grounding): **4 stars, 1 fork** as of **Nov 18, 2026**.
- [ora-grounding — install note](https://github.com/AuremHQ/ora-grounding): README says `pip install ora-grounding` — PyPI listing NOT VERIFIED (fetch blocked Nov 18, 2026). Confirm on PyPI before citing the install command as working.
